lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority

lines.value: New registration applications for orthodox medicines are submitted on the SAHPRA Engagement Portal in line with current guidelines, with GMP-compliant sites and a completed SCoRE document.

lines.label: Scheme

source.publisher: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority

lines.value: GS1 Data Matrix carrying GTIN (01), expiry (17), batch/lot (10) and later serial number (21)

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: South African Health Products Regulatory Authority

lines.value: Primary and secondary packs carry a GS1 Data Matrix; batch-level data (GTIN, expiry YYMMDD, batch) is required from 1 October 2027 for imported and 1 October 2029 for domestic products, and a serial number is added from 1 October 2029 and 1 October 2031 respectively; tertiary packs may use GS1 Data Matrix or GS1-128, and GTINs are assigned per packaging level.
